title: RAW UNREVIEWED: inner bark and outer bark are separate harvested materials
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Seek a dated botanical or materia medica primary that explicitly distinguishes inner from outer bark of the same named tree and specifies which layer is harvested or discarded. A target needs two separately owned layer depictions or source-bound uses on admitted material; a generic thick root or trunk is not sufficient. Check existing part-class and quality failures before selection.

design.mechanism: nested layer and selective harvesting of one owned tree
design.unit: complete same-tree source entry and owner-bound target material references
design.contrast: inner-versus-outer layer terms versus general bark or quality epithet
design.prediction: two fixed complete forms distinguish retained and removed layers while keeping tree identity constant
